applications.detail.error.approval_start: An approval already started for this application. Open it and choose Retry to finish, or Undo to remove what was created, before deciding again.
applications.detail.error.busy: Someone else is working on this application right now. Wait a moment and try again.
applications.detail.error.fields_require: Choose at least one question for the applicant to answer.
applications.detail.error.message_requir: Write a message so the applicant knows what to send.
applications.detail.error.not_open: This application was already decided, so nothing changed. Refresh the page to see its current status.
applications.detail.error.note_required: Write something before saving the note.
approval.blocked.no_b2b: Your Shopify plan doesn't include B2B, so Shopify can't create a company for this buyer yet. The application stays in your queue: approve it once B2B is available (Basic plan or higher with the new Markets). Home shows what your plan supports.
approval.skip.no_b2b: B2B isn't available on this store's Shopify plan.

email.merchant_digest.weeklyBody: Here's what needs your attention in Tradepass this week.
email.merchant_info_received.subject: {company} sent the information you asked for
form.template.applied: Template applied. Check the preview, then save.
form.template.body: Pick the kind of business you sell to. The template decides which questions the form asks and which ones are required. Your own questions, texts and consent wording stay as they are, and nothing changes on your store until you click Save.
form.template.desc.distributor: Asks for a tax number, website, phone and expected monthly order value; year established is optional.
form.template.desc.other: The standard form: business details, contact, addresses, optional tax number and documents.
form.template.desc.reseller: Asks for a tax number, a resale certificate and the website or marketplace where they sell.
form.template.desc.restaurant: Asks for a phone number and lets buyers give a separate delivery address and number of sites.
form.template.desc.retail: Asks for a tax registration number; website, number of locations and expected order value are optional.
form.template.desc.salon: Asks for a professional licence or certificate upload and a phone number.
form.template.heading: Start from a template
form.template.label: Business type
home.pending.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# approval stopped part-way and needs Retry or Undo} other {# approvals stopped part-way and need Retry or Undo}}
home.report.heading: Last 6 months
home.report.tierLine: {tier}: {active, plural, one {# active buyer} other {# active buyers}}{paused, plural, =0 {} one { · # paused} other { · # paused}}
home.setup.body: Answer a few questions and Tradepass sets up your application form, your first wholesale price tier and what shoppers see. It takes about five minutes, and you can change everything later.
notifications.merchant.mode.weekly.help: One email each Monday (UTC) with pending applications, replies to your questions, expiring certificates and failed actions from the past week. Sent only when there's something to report.
settings.countries.body: Choose which countries wholesale buyers can apply from, based on their billing address. Applicants from other countries see a short message in the form before they fill everything in.
settings.countries.errorEmpty: Tick at least one country, or choose “Every country”.
settings.countries.heading: Who can apply
settings.countries.mode.all.help: Anyone can apply. Recommended unless there are places you can't ship to.
settings.countries.mode.allow.help: Applicants must have a billing address in one of the countries ticked below.
settings.countries.mode.block: Every country except the ones I choose
settings.countries.mode.block.help: Applicants with a billing address in a ticked country can't apply.
settings.countries.note: The list is ignored while “Every country” is selected. Existing applications and buyers aren't affected.
settings.countries.syncFailed: Settings saved, but the storefront form couldn't be updated yet. It will update the next time you save, or open Help → Diagnostics.
settings.privacy.applications: {count, plural, =0 {No applications} one {# application} other {# applications}}
settings.privacy.body: When a customer asks a store for their data, Shopify tells Tradepass. Each request appears here so you can download what Tradepass holds about that customer (applications, answers, tax numbers and documents) and send it to them. Deletion requests are handled automatically.
settings.privacy.empty: No data requests in the last 12 months.
settings.privacy.heading: Privacy requests
settings.privacy.notFound: This request is no longer available.
setup.access.intro: Approved buyers who are logged in always see their wholesale prices. This only decides what everyone else sees.
setup.access.title: What should shoppers who aren't wholesale buyers see?
setup.access.wholesaleOnly: Your store is wholesale-only: only approved buyers can check out. Change this on the Storefront access page.
setup.access.wholesaleOnlyLater: Want a store only approved buyers can order from? Choose the wholesale-only store on the Storefront access page after setup.
setup.business.intro: We'll set up your application form with the questions that kind of business can answer. You can change any question later.
setup.business.note: This updates the questions on your default form. Your own questions and texts are kept.
setup.business.title: Who do you sell wholesale to?
setup.done.toast: Setup finished. Applications will appear under Applications.
setup.error.chooseBusiness: Choose the kind of business you sell to.
setup.error.syncFailed: Shopify didn't accept the change, so nothing changed on your store. Try again in a moment.
setup.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Refresh the page and try again.
setup.plan.b2bNo: Business customers (B2B): not available on this plan. You can still collect applications.
setup.plan.b2bYes: Business customers (B2B): available. Approved buyers become Shopify companies.
setup.plan.intro: Tradepass uses Shopify's own B2B features: companies, wholesale price lists and payment terms. Here's what your store can use today.
setup.plan.marketsBody: In Shopify admin go to Settings → Markets. Once B2B markets are available, come back and create your tier. Everything else works already.
setup.plan.marketsHeading: Turn on the new Shopify Markets
setup.plan.noB2bBody: Shopify includes B2B on Basic, Grow and Advanced (with the new Markets) and on Plus. Until then you can set up the form, collect applications and review them; approving waits until B2B is available.
setup.plan.pricesNo: Wholesale prices: Shopify Markets needs to be turned on before tiers can have their own prices.
setup.plan.pricesYes: Wholesale prices: available. Each tier gets its own price list.
setup.plan.tiersLimit: Price tiers: your plan allows {limit, plural, one {# B2B price list} other {# B2B price lists}} in total; {free, plural, =0 {none are free right now} one {# is free} other {# are free}}.
setup.plan.tiersPlus: Price tiers: as many as you need (Shopify Plus).
setup.plan.tiersUnknown: Price tiers: Shopify didn't tell us your limit right now. It's checked again when you create a tier.
setup.plan.title: What your Shopify plan supports
setup.plan.tradepassFree: You're on Tradepass Free: 1 tier and {approvals} approvals a month. Paid plans start with a 14-day free trial.
setup.theme.blockBody: Create a page (for example “Wholesale”, so its address is {url}), then add the “Wholesale application” block to it.
setup.theme.blockTitle: 2. Add the application form to a page
setup.theme.embedBody: Needed for hiding prices and the “Apply for wholesale” buttons. It doesn't change how your store looks until you choose so.
setup.theme.embedTitle: 1. Turn on the Tradepass app embed
setup.theme.intro: Two switches in your theme editor. Each opens in a new tab; save the theme there, then come back and click Check again.
setup.theme.title: Add Tradepass to your online store
setup.theme.viewForm: View the form on my store
setup.tier.blockedHeading: You can't create a tier yet
setup.tier.discountHelp: Between 1% and 90%. Applies to every product; you can limit it to collections later.
setup.tier.existing: {count, plural, one {You already have a tier: {names}.} other {You already have # tiers: {names}.}}
setup.tier.intro: A tier is a wholesale price level, such as 20% off your normal prices. Every approved buyer is placed in a tier and sees its prices when logged in.
setup.tier.name: Tier name
setup.tier.nameHelp: Only you see this name. Buyers see the prices, not the name.
setup.tier.note: Tradepass creates the price list and catalog in Shopify for you. Payment terms and tax settings can be added later on the Tiers page.
setup.tier.title: Your first price tier
setup.title: Set up Tradepass
